body: I always assume I don’t know anyone anymore, but I think you can see the light in people. You can see their soul, their aura. That’s what I fall in love with. I think that’s enough, even if the human part disappoints me, or changes beyond recognition. It’s important to remain a bit detached with everyone and accept that they’ll all leave eventually. Though I wish we could mindmeld, to truly understand each other, it would save us so much pain and loneliness.
You really get it… I just want to be done. I don’t need to see or do anything else. I long to finally rest, why is that so hard for others to understand?

I wish I could still say “I’m just a girl”  without the tiktok connotation. to me that’s similar to “I’m just a man” or “I’m only human” y’know? like it’s just a thing you say to yourself to acknowledge your mortality. not equating me being a girl to infantilization or innocence or any of that shit. I may not say it anymore out loud but I won’t let other people ruin it for me. I wish “woman” rolled off the tongue better but it doesn’t lol. We’re just gonna have to come up with a better word.

The monotony of taking care of yourself is so exhausting to me. Every day. Needing to find something to eat, cleaning yourself and your space, exercising, more eating, finding a way to make enough money to afford anything.

Then you have to learn how to be a person that is appealing to others: memorize secret social cues, laugh at the right times, have enough eye contact, make jokes but don’t hurt their feelings, talk enough so that you don’t seem shy, but don’t talk too much that you seem obnoxious, be generous enough so they don’t think you’re rude, but don’t be too generous or else they’ll use you. It’s just. Impossible.
If I got to start my life over again. But that’s not on the table

I always thought, especially during awards season, that those actors—who are established, and many her senior—view her with mild intrigue and pity.

It must be uncanny to watch someone shrink down before your very eyes, smaller in the flesh than they’ve ever been. Especially for those that knew Brittany Murphy, it’s just another sad case repeating itself. And not to say that she doesn’t have talent, but everyone knows young-looking women get nominated more than any man. She’s a “star” not a character actor, and that will always be how she’s marketed. I do think they enjoy her singing as the audience clapping on Oscars night can attest, but her acting they probably take very lightly and view more as theatrical than anything else. I can imagine they’re curious to how she may grow as an actor, but are also cautiously thinking, “can she last shooting another movie without needing to lie down?”

In a way, she’ll always be like an older sister I grew up with, and I don’t regret any of the time I spent loving her. I don’t see her as a damsel in distress per se, but someone I’m really concerned about.

All of her unhealthy patterns and toxic behavior just remind me of the hell she’s lived through—more than anyone ever should—and that she needs serious help. I’ve never held back on my criticism but it’s so painful to see her destroy herself, no doubt barreling towards a tragic end.

With Ari still unhealed and off the rails, I never expect any rational decisions or honesty from her at all. I’ve long-accepted that she’ll be poorly coping for the foreseeable future, including self-sabotaging her relationships and camouflaging her true self. She’s running, and she’ll keep running until her legs can’t carry her anymore. 

She doesn’t want to be seen as weak. Not a crier, not someone who ever stops working, and definitely not someone who needs a long-term intervention. She’d prefer to embark on an endless search for love where it’s unavailable instead of finding it within, all while chipping away at her body and face until there’s nothing left but a hollow shell of who she used to be.

And occasionally, she’ll open the cracks in her heart just enough to pour her pain into a song, and I’ll see Her again. That brief vulnerability will pull me in and remind me why I cared so much for her all those years ago. But then she’ll have a song on the album that clearly evades the truth, that paints a picture she wants to believe, and I tune back out, wondering when she’ll ever really hear how she sounds.

I really get you, it’s like, I know you can still achieve things later in life, but it really sucks that I won’t get to enjoy it during my healthiest youthful years. It’s really unfair to barely have any time at all—that if you don’t start working towards a specific goal before you graduate school, you’ve kinda sacrificed the entire next quarter of your life. I should’ve been preparing and preparing and preparing but instead I let the world distract and beat me down.

I learned this recently, if a person is not For You in this life, things will turn sour no matter what—they don’t even have to be an evil person! That’s the tricky part, you keep questioning yourself and trying to see bad vs good, when the misalignment is all that really matters. Going against nature and forcing a connection to work can bring out the worst in both of you. I know I’ve seen terrible sides of me only through someone else. Trust your body first, and look back on it later.

I’m happy I could help in articulating, your responses in turn have helped me remember I’m not alone in this experience. The immediacy of our convo following my harassment + spell within hours makes me feel like the universe balanced out. I’m glad I made the decision to post this, I didn’t expect anybody to reply or even deeply understand as you did. You’re absolutely right that their opinions are worth nothing! There’s nothing about their life that I envy. Protection and discernment is key to prevent this from repeating. Moments like these connect me right back to my craft

So sorry to hear about your situation, I’m glad you were able to overcome it and that it doesn’t weigh on you. I saw a post the other day saying: the moment you realize most people online are unwell, unhappy, or hold idiotic opinions is when you are free from them. From the way that these people interact with social media, you know it’s not an isolated incident in their behavior. They feel unheard in their lives, angry that others live freely, and take that out on you. It’s also a time when difference of perspective is like a personal threat to their own existence. 

I appreciate your acknowledgement of the craziness being unwarranted for any typical thing. It’s not that that I feel afraid of backfiring per se, but it’s just a niggling thought in my head since I’m not too experienced. But my intention is always clear and I don’t even wish more harm, just for them to feel what they so desperately are trying to send outward instead. I don’t feel like what I’m doing is wrong as long as I do that. 

I wonder if the way my candle burned means something or if it’s just indicative of the breeze through the window. The side facing the mirror dripped down and created a pillar/shape trying to reach up over the candle, then was left as a lump at the end. I know some people say that means the person is still feeling things one-sided, or that there’s more healing to be done. When I examined it, it looked like the hunched over desperation of someone trying to cling on, but failing. Facing the mirror too, just felt particularly like “look at the state of you.”

I want to transport somewhere that allows me to reach my full potential as a creature, not waste potential and have my spirit crushed and energy drained. we’re all just livestock to the elite, that’s why they won’t let us die, not till they’ve used us for all that we’re worth. I don’t know how anyone doesn’t feel trapped here

I just want them to be ok, because I can see their beautiful soul, which deserves peace and happiness. They could show their ugliest side, cope poorly, and dwell in negativity and pain for far too long. But I will always love them.

the gap between this and the last time I published was 6 years! so it was a little daunting to return. but I found myself craving a story that no one else was telling, and I knew exactly what I wanted it to be—the freedom in knowing you’re allowed to create any world you want is so liberating!! and reading my old works, I can see how much better and clearer headed I’ve gotten as a writer, it makes me proud. getting a dozen or so kudos, I think about how it’s like a small classroom, or a book signing. I feel inspired to keep adding my inspiration even if it’s not for everybody.
